plan.summary: Deploy a serverless webhook ingestion and asynchronous event routing microservice on Google Cloud Run using Google Cloud Native Buildpacks, Cloud Pub/Sub push subscriptions, a 7-day lifecycle Cloud Storage archive bucket, and Firestore audit logging.
plan.architecture_overview: A single-service serverless event-driven architecture hosted on Cloud Run v2 (ex01-live) in us-central1, scaling from 0 to 3 instances and built via Google Cloud Native Buildpacks without manual Dockerfiles. Public webhook requests hit POST /api/v1/events, validate payload schemas (event_type, source_system, payload, timestamp), and publish to the test-events-inbound Cloud Pub/Sub topic. An authenticated Pub/Sub push subscription invokes POST /api/v1/tasks/process on the same Cloud Run service using OIDC token verification to persist raw JSON payloads into a regional Cloud Storage bucket configured with a 7-day auto-deletion lifecycle policy and write indexed audit documents to the Firestore Native collection event_audit_records. A GET /health endpoint exposes operational status, service name, and IaC engine metadata. Because no Compute Engine VMs are provisioned, the VM External IP prohibition policy is natively satisfied without requiring VPC or Cloud NAT infrastructure.
